name: uberasm-customizable-mid-air-jumps
title: Customizable Mid-Air Jumps
description:
This gives Mario the ability to perform and store multiple midair jumps.

This ASM is customizable:
- Ground, swimming, and climbing reset behavior
- Separate reset amounts for each state
- Upward midair jumps
- B/A or L/R controls
- Spin jumping while holding an item
- Cape-flight jumps, flight preservation, and flight spin jumps
- Normal and spin jump heights
- Number of jumps granted by the custom coin
- Maximum number of stored jump
